subject: Distributor allocation & pass-through language — proposed redline and audit evidence
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@marketsphere.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@resellerco.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Distributor allocation & pass-through language — request for clarity and ledger

Ben / Marissa,

Thanks for getting this across the finish line so far. Our legal team reviewed the proposed reseller addendum and flagged two items that need clearer mechanics before we can sign:

1) "Pass-through" for marketplace fees — MarketSphere prefers pass-through but wants a clear waterfall for which entity is invoiced and when.
2) Audit rights related to commissions — we can accept a limited audit but need clarity on scope, notice, and what records you expect.

To move quickly, can you: 1) provide the redline language you propose for the pass-through waterfall, and 2) confirm what ledger evidence you'd expect (format and retention period)? Emma from ResellerCo is copied to confirm whether they can provide a sample ledger export.

We'd like to avoid an open-ended audit. If you propose limiting to two fiscal quarters and remote access to CSV exports, that would be more workable for us.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Lee
Head of Partnerships, MarketSphere
jordan.lee@marketsphere.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachment: none

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@marketsphere.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Distributor allocation & pass-through language — proposed redline and audit evidence

Jordan — appreciate the quick read. High-level proposal from our side:

- Replace the current ambiguous pass-through paragraph with a short waterfall: (1) Redwood invoices Customer directly in the marketplace channel; (2) any marketplace platform fees are itemized on the same invoice and passed through at cost to the Customer; (3) Reseller/Distributor receives a separate commission reconciled monthly.

- Audit scope: Redwood is comfortable with a one-time, limited-scope audit covering two consecutive fiscal quarters, remote only (CSV export + sample invoices), 30 days' notice, and redaction rights for unrelated PII. No onsite audits.

I've attached a working doc with the proposed tracked-changes language and a sample commission export (anonymized). Kim, can you weigh in on liability allocation and the indemnity carveouts below? Karthik / Marissa — if this sounds good to you I'll send to Emma for confirmation and push for DocuSign-ready order form.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Channel Sales — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachment: MS_OrderForm_TrackChanges.docx; commission-ledger.csv

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@marketsphere.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Distributor allocation & pass-through language — proposed redline and audit evidence

On Tue, Aug 17, 2026 at 11:30 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jordan — appreciate the quick read. High-level proposal from our side:
>
> - Replace the current ambiguous pass-through paragraph with a short waterfall...
> - Audit scope: Redwood is comfortable with a one-time, limited-scope audit...

Thanks Ben — reviewing. A few legal-level edits and clarifications to propose before we send to MarketSphere/ResellerCo:

1) Liability reallocation: we should avoid language that could be interpreted as transferring Redwood's product liability to the Reseller. Suggest: "Reseller shall be responsible for distribution-related taxes, marketplace platform fees and commission reconciliation; Redwood remains responsible for product/service performance, security, and indemnity obligations arising from Redwood's service."

2) Audit carve-out: good to limit to two fiscal quarters, remote, 30 days' notice. Add: audit limited to records "directly relating to commissions and marketplace fee calculations for the covered quarters"; Redwood may provide CSV exports and supporting invoices, and may redact customer-identifying PII and non-relevant ledger lines. No invoice-level re-pricing via audit; remedies limited to recalculation of commission amounts and a single reimbursement if an error > 1% is found.

3) Indemnity cap: propose we keep the indemnity and liability cap consistent with the MSA (reference section x.y) rather than creating a separate unlimited exposure via the addendum.

4) Confidentiality: if the partner insists on more frequent audits, require an NDA addendum and a third-party auditor mutually agreed upon.

I attached the SOC2 summary we typically share with partners — please request a current SOC2 attestation from MarketSphere if they ask for deeper access. Ben — please confirm if you want me to insert these edits into the tracked-changes file or propose alternative wording.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Attachment: SOC2-Summary.pdf

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@marketsphere.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@resellerco.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Distributor allocation & pass-through language — proposed redline and audit evidence

Thanks Kim & Ben — appreciate the clarity. Emma uploaded a cleaned commission export and a signed reseller addendum draft (see attached). Per your proposed edits:

- MarketSphere accepts the waterfall language with the caveat that itemized marketplace fees must be visible on the invoice for reconciliation.
- Audit scope: agreed to limited remote audit for two consecutive quarters. We're good with 30 days' notice and the limitation to commission/fee calculations. We also accept the 1% tolerance threshold on recalculation remedies.

Action items:
- Ben: can you insert Kim's language about indemnity cap and upload the updated tracked doc to the Drive link so procurement can kick off DocuSign?
- Marissa/Karthik: please confirm timing for DocuSign — MarketSphere hopes to close the signed order form by Aug 26 to hit their fiscal cutoff.

I'll attach the CSV export (commission-ledger.csv) and the reseller's signed copy for your records. If you need a SOC2 attestation rather than a summary, I can ask Emma to pull the cert.

Best,
Jordan
Attachment: commission-ledger.csv; Reseller_Signed_Addendum.pdf
